name: Maristan
mission: To offer culturally and religiously tailored mental health services, creating a secure haven for individuals to explore well-being within their faith. We strive to raise awareness about mental health in Muslim communities and beyond, breaking down stigmas and fostering a supportive environment for holistic healing.
theoryOfChange: By integrating Islamic principles and evidence-based mental health practices, Maristan strives to empower minds and inspire transformative change, building a world where mental health is prioritized.
scoreSummary: Too early to rate numerically. This organization was founded in 2022 and is shown as an emerging organization while it builds a public track record.

In FY2024, the group generated <cite id="3">$658,402 in revenue</cite> [3], expanding its reach through initiatives such as <cite id="4">suicide response certification</cite> and specialized clinical support [4]. Financial management shows high fundraising efficiency, with <cite id="1">costs of $0.08 to $0.15 per $1 raised</cite>, alongside <cite id="1">13.3 months of working capital</cite> that cushions operations [1].
rich_narrative.summary: Maristan provides community mental health services and suicide prevention training through a culturally focused lens. In FY2024, Maristan reported <cite id="3">total revenue of $658,402</cite> to support its clinical and educational initiatives [3]. The organization operates community-focused clinical services and delivers <cite id="4">specialized suicide response certification training</cite> tailored for leaders and care providers [4]. As an early-stage nonprofit founded in 2022, its revenue grew from $129,957 in FY2022 to $658,402 in FY2024, representing early-stage expansion from a small base. Maristan operates as a <cite id="2">zakat-eligible organization</cite> serving designated categories of need [2]. It maintains a strong liquidity position with <cite id="1">13.3 months of working capital</cite> to ensure operational stability [1]. However, program expense breakdown data remains unknown, and the organization has limited external evidence tracking its long-term clinical outcomes.
